reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a OneCoin educational package bundled with tokens and presents access to ONE Academy as a path into practicing with the purported cryptocurrency. A separately cited U.S. Justice Department account identifies OneCoin's educational-and-token packages as products sold within a fraudulent cryptocurrency scheme. The video does not state the package price; that program-level sales context is external, not a price spoken in this video.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
As you progress up the knowledge ladder to level six, you will understand the theoretical foundation of finance and trading and also get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.
I would like to wish you success with your studies in one academy.

opening.argument: Judge this by what the presentation actually promises. It describes the program as a way to gain knowledge about finance and digital currencies, then calls the tokens an opportunity to put that knowledge into practice. Those are educational claims, not a guarantee that a token will appreciate or pay dividends. There is no explicit risk warning, but there is also no stated return, income figure or assurance against loss. The absence of a warning should not turn a claim about learning into a claim about profit.

citations.quote: First, you gain knowledge.
Second, you get the opportunity to put your knowledge into practice.
Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited package line establishes a bundle, not a promise that its tokens will increase in value. The next line says the tools let learners practice what they have studied; it does not specify a return or even a purchase price. The opening invokes an outside account of the broader program, but that account is not among the supplied primary sources. Its description cannot establish what financial claim this video makes.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A guaranteed return is not necessary to recognize this promotion. The presentation directs viewers to obtain an educational package with tokens, then links those tokens to practicing with ONE coin. Calling that practice does not make the token bundle incidental to the offer. The video does not disclose a price or a completed sale, but those omissions do not erase the solicitation it does contain.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.

opening.argument: The presentation is organized around a curriculum: lower levels cover basic finance and the monetary system, while upper levels address digital currencies. It also shows an information-center interface, and a speaker discusses his teaching background and wishes viewers success with their studies. Read in that context, the token reference describes a practical component of a course. The cited material does not show a trading result, a price forecast or instructions to invest.

citations.quote: While lower levels teach you about the basics of finance, financial management, and the monetary system, upper levels bring you closer to the world of digital economy
I'm already 10 years teaching at the University of National and World Economy where I'm an assistant professor.
I would like to wish you success with your studies in one academy.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening isolates the package and ONE coin lines from the course structure surrounding them. The same narration describes progressively harder learning resources and moving from financial basics to digital currencies. The speaker's closing wish concerns studies, not investment gains. The external account cited in the opening may bear on the wider program, but the supplied video evidence presents the tokens as part of practical learning.

citations.quote: ONE Academy is a fantastic opportunity to get access to learning resources organized in levels with asc outstanding order of difficulty.
I would like to wish you success with your studies in one academy.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The educational framing is real, but it is also how the token offer is delivered. The narration tells viewers to get a package along with tokens and promises tools to practice with ONE coin at level six. A curriculum and a teacher's introduction do not negate that explicit promotion; the opening's quotes establish educational context, not that the token component is merely a neutral demonstration.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.

opening.argument: The concrete offer described here is an educational package with learning resources, levels and tokens for practical experience. Even accepting that this is promotion, the supplied material does not give a package price, ask viewers to deposit funds, promise returns, or describe income from recruiting others. Its reference to logging in concerns a username and password, not a request to disclose them to the speaker. On this record, the observable pitch is for access to a course and its accompanying tools; a fraudulent financial transaction is not shown.

citations.quote: ONE Academy is a fantastic opportunity to get access to learning resources organized in levels with asc outstanding order of difficulty.
Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
Log on with your username and password and enter a whole new world of opportunities.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference opening is right that the package includes tokens; it does not show a price, payment instruction or completed purchase in this video. Its claim about packages being sold in a fraudulent scheme depends on a separately cited account that is not supplied here as primary material. The strongest video-grounded conclusion is narrower: the speaker promotes a package associated with ONE coin. That alone does not establish the missing transaction or financial payoff.

citations.quote: Get your educational package along with tokens and combine your knowledge with practical experience.
get the tools to practice your knowledge with ONE coin.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Missing price and payment footage limit what can be claimed about a completed transaction, not what the presentation promotes. It tells viewers to get an educational package bundled with tokens and identifies ONE coin as the tool for practice. The ordinary-course reading overlooks that the tokens are expressly part of what viewers are urged to obtain; the absence of a deposit instruction or guaranteed return does not remove that mechanism from the video.
